body:
## 📝 Description
Implements Enterprise Industrial Carbon Capture, Utilization & Storage (CCUS) Suite for eco-buddy-ai, providing flue gas CO2 absorption telemetry, Direct Air Capture (DAC) monitoring, and Section 45Q carbon credit tracking.

Key highlights:
- Added engine service (`industrial_ccus_engine.py`).
- Created Streamlit interface (`pages/Industrial_CCUS_Studio.py`).
- Created React dashboard component (`src/components/ccus/IndustrialCcusDashboardView.tsx`).
- Added unit tests (`test_industrial_ccus_engine.py`).

Closes #937
